mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (study_id, sender_id, message, created_at) VALUES (#{studyId}, #{senderId}, #{message}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.study_id, c.sender_id, u.nickname as senderNickname, c.message, c.created_at FROM chat_message c JOIN westudy.user u ON c.sender_id = u.id WHERE c.study_id = #{studyId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT s.id AS studyId, s.post_id AS postId, s.title, s.location, s.max_member AS maxMember, s.state, CASE WHEN s.user_id = #{userId} THEN true ELSE false END AS isHost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS approvedMemberCount, (SELECT message FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.study_id = s.id ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage FROM study s LEFT JOIN study_participant sp ON s.id = sp.study_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.delete_at IS NULL AND (s.user_id = #{userId} OR sp.status = 'APPROVED') ORDER BY (SELECT cm.created_at FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.study_id = s.id ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, s.created_at DESC
